name: The Metropolitan District (MDC) - Hartford Water Pollution Control Facility and combined sewer system
receiving_waters: Park River Conduit / Park River Auxiliary Conduit
North Meadows Storage Pond via Tower Brook Conduit
outfalls_source: https://services1.arcgis.com/FjPcSmEFuDYlIdKC/arcgis/rest/services/NPDES_Outfalls/FeatureServer/0 (ICIS pull 2026-01-14); DEEP regulator layer https://services1.arcgis.com/FjPcSmEFuDYlIdKC/arcgis/rest/services/CSO_and_CSO_Groups/FeatureServer/0; EPA R1 https://services.arcgis.com/cJ9YHowT8TU7DUyn/ArcGIS/rest/services/R1_Combined_Sewer_Outfall__CSO__Locations__2022/FeatureServer/1
notification_channel: CT DEEP Performance Dashboard (QScend QAlert reports shown in Zoho Analytics open views: https://deepct.qscend.mygovcenter.com/cms/cms?id=1); X/Twitter @CTSewageSpills (manual DEEP posts). Statutory local notice: operator must notify the chief elected official and local health official within 2 h; they must inform the public within 2 h of receipt (CGS 22a-424a(c)(3)) - channel varies by town. MDC itself: no CSO event page found on themdc.org; 'MDC Alerts' (Everbridge, https://member.everbridge.net/453003085612528/new) is described as water/sewer emergencies (water main breaks), not CSO notices; X @mdcwater, Facebook mdcwater; physical outfall signs ('Wet Weather Sewage Discharge Outfall #040'). Clean Water Project site thecleanwaterproject.com has no event feed.
notes: ICIS lists 39 external outfalls (001 = treated effluent to CT River + 38 CSOs); EPA R1 2022 lists 38 CSO outfalls. DEEP dashboard reports MDC CSOs by group ('Conduits', 'CT River', 'Free-Flowing North Branch', 'Free-Flowing South Branch', 'Folly Brook', 'Kane Brook'), not by outfall; 2026 rows have CSO Group Name and Receiving Waterbody null in the public view. 2025: 50 CSO reports, 82 overflow days, 524,114,000 gal (DEEP 2026 annual report); plus 52 NPDES permitted bypasses at Hartford WPCF, 612.3 MG (counted as SSO/bypass). Consent Order COWRMU22002 (2022, modified 2023 and 2025). South Hartford Conveyance and Storage Tunnel (~41 MG) due Dec 31 2026. Other MDC plants: East Hartford CT0100170, Rocky Hill CT0100480, Windsor-Poquonock CT0100994. Emergency line 860-278-7850 press 1.
